requirement.title: 从零构建杨千嬅主题非官方粉丝网站
requirement.summary: Go/HTML/native JavaScript site: fans, music previews, albums and minimal administrator management, with real local functional tests.

sources.content: 用户原需求：做一个杨千嬅主题个人粉丝网站，Go+jQuery+HTML，基本展示、用户（粉丝）体系、音乐试听、相册、简单后台。后续明确批准既有Go版本，必要时原生JavaScript代替jQuery，合理精简环境；目标是通用SDLC验证，不是生产上线。本次保留全部模块，限定WAV试听与PNG/JPEG相片、单进程本地JSON，三工作项衔接验证。

goals.problem: No usable application exists in the new versioned scaffold.
goals.outcome: A complete local fan site with connected public/account/media/admin functions and traceable lifecycle.
goals.success_condition: All stated acceptance conditions pass on the current final implementation; formal VFY, local Sandbox RLS and Status agree.

in_scope: Public site and native frontend assets
Bounded WAV previews and image albums
Local transactional persistence, offline tests and Sandbox lifecycle
out_of_scope: Distributed persistence, translation, SEO or feature expansion

requirements.statement: Display an unofficial Miriam Yeung themed home, music, album and account pages using Go, HTML and native JavaScript without remote page dependencies.
Fans can register, log in, view/edit only their own profile and log out; email is normalized and unique, input limits apply.
Use explicit one-time administrator initialization; ordinary registration cannot grant roles. Only enabled admins manage users, homepage, tracks, albums and photos.

Use salted slow password derivation, random expiring opaque sessions, protected cookies, CSRF and same-origin checks. Disable revokes current and stale-generation sessions; re-enable needs a new login.
Published WAV previews support real GET/HEAD/Range; drafts, removed and unpublished media remain inaccessible by direct URL.
Administrators create/edit/publish/unpublish/delete albums, upload bounded PNG/JPEG photos and delete photos. Associations persist and removed albums expose no orphan images.
Administrators can edit public site text and create/edit/publish/unpublish/delete music, and list/enable/disable fans without disabling the last management account.

Persist users, site, albums and music in a single-process local JSON store across restart. Concurrent updates preserve uniqueness and no lost writes; persistence failure does not publish partial in-memory state.
Reject unauthorized, unknown-field, oversized or malformed writes. Escape user content, bound media types and sizes, and do not expose credential material.
Use no artist recordings/photos or real customer data; provide generated test-media tooling, complete source/license and run instructions. RLS is local Sandbox only, not application deployment.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Read all public pages and native assets
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Pages/assets load, unofficial notice present; unauthenticated profile/admin denied.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Register, edit profile, logout, replay cookie and login again
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Own profile persists; old cookie rejected; duplicate normalized email, invalid email/password and oversized fields rejected.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Bootstrap, normal register and try administrative routes/role injection
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Only the explicitly bootstrapped administrator manages content/users; fan or forged role input does not escalate.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Disable/re-enable, expire/replay sessions, tamper CSRF and Origin
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Current and stale login generations remain revoked, invalid writes denied, required cookie flags set and no plaintext stored.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Create a draft track, publish and retrieve full/ranged audio, then unpublish/delete
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Actual bytes match; HEAD empty, valid Range206/invalid Range416; unpublished/deleted URLs404.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Create/edit album, upload valid/invalid photo, publish/unpublish and delete
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Valid photo round-trips; bad type/size/missing association rejected; no direct draft or orphan media access.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Admin edits homepage and manages listings and fan state
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Current public text reflects edits, lists show actual records, administrator disable rejected and fan disable enforced.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Restart, race duplicate registration and content writes, inject storage failure
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Entities and references survive; sessions restart invalid; exactly one duplicate account, no lost updates, rejected write preserves memory/disk.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Send bad content types/unknown JSON fields/oversized bodies and display markup text
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: Requests rejected without unauthorized state changes; template and JS text nodes escape untrusted content.

acceptance_criteria.condition: Inspect run instructions, licensing, sample generator and full combined user journey
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: No unlicensed media or actual secrets; source builds offline, generated media plays, whole fan/admin journey succeeds.

lifecycle_applicability.basis: Multi-module design, dependency-ordered implementation, current-result verification and local Sandbox delivery.
